utterances.speaker: JUDGE SCHOMBURG
utterances.text: Good afternoon. May we first of all wait -- do you have something before the witness appears?

utterances.speaker: MR. KOUMJIAN
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SCHOMBURG
utterances.text: So we start in open session. Could you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes, good afternoon. This is Case Number IT-97-24-PT, the Prosecutor versus Milomir Stakic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SCHOMBURG
utterances.text: The appearances, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOUMJIAN
utterances.text: Nicholas Koumjian with Ruth Karper, case manager, for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SCHOMBURG
utterances.text: And for the Defence, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Branko Lukic for the Defence, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SCHOMBURG
utterances.text: May I just ask, is it the intention of your colleague to appear this week?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: He'll be back on Wednesday, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SCHOMBURG
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. Then the Office of the Prosecutor has a problem.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOUMJIAN
utterances.text: It is not a problem, Your Honour, but I have been requested by Ms. Korner, who is, as you know, also leading the ARK case, the Talic-Brdjanin trial, to request this Court to release to the Defence lawyers, in this case, the transcript of Witness A in this case, the reason being that there is an application by the Prosecution to 92 bis in that trial. Mr. Witness A's testimony in this trial, and we would just be seeking permission to the Court to release only to the Defence attorneys for Mr. Brdjanin and Talic that testimony, so they could respond to our 92 bis motion.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SCHOMBURG
utterances.text: Could you agree that we first wait until we have finalised the hearing of Witness A in this case?

utterances.speaker: MR. KOUMJIAN
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SCHOMBURG
utterances.text: Any objections from the Defence?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: No objections, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SCHOMBURG
utterances.text: So then it may be no problems. You may use the transcript in the other case. May we -- any other administrative matters in the afternoon today?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: We have nothing, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOUMJIAN
utterances.text: Just regarding scheduling, I would imagine that we have another witness present who will be available on Thursday, and I am assuming that that would be a good approximation of when the cross-examination -- he also could be available Wednesday afternoon, if counsel believes there's a chance that that would be possible.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SCHOMBURG
utterances.text: May I just interrupt. First of all, the question with priority is the one, I'm afraid, that we can't finalise the cross-examination and the additional questions from the side of the Judges as regards Witness A today. And therefore, my intention is, if all participants agree and are available, we should proceed tomorrow, 9.00. Would that be correct for you?

utterances.speaker: MR. KOUMJIAN
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: We can proceed tomorrow, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SCHOMBURG
utterances.text: Okay. Then let's do our very best to proceed as far as possible today, but still with the possibility of continuing tomorrow in the morning. Could you please bring in the Witness A. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOUMJIAN
utterances.text: Closed session, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SCHOMBURG
utterances.text: It's closed session now, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes, we are in closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: 6.54 p.m., to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 23rd day of April, 2002, at 9.30 a.m. 19 20 21 22 23 24 25
